title: Localized cofibrant total categories and coherent Quillen sections
statement: Let $D$ be a dg Quillen diagram [def-coef-dg-quillen-diagram], with strict sections [def-coef-strict-quillen-sections]. Its cofibrant total category has objects $(i,A)$ with $A$ cofibrant in $M_i$, and arrows $(\alpha,f):(i,A)\to(j,B)$ where $f:F_\alpha A\to B$. Identity is $(1_i,u_i)$ and composition is $(\alpha\gg\beta,c^{-1}_{\alpha,\beta}F_\beta(f)g)$. Projection to $I$ and fiber inclusions are specified on both objects and arrows. Vertical weak equivalences are $(1_i,u_i g)$ for fiber weak equivalences $g$. Given universal fiber localizations $q_i:N(M_i)\to L_i$ in the full coherent sense of [lem-coef-finite-reedy-localization], a localized derived diagram consists of a universal localization $q_T:N(T)\to G$ at those vertical weak equivalences, over $N(I)$, that is a cocartesian fibration [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. The images of $(\alpha,id):(i,A)\to(j,F_\alpha A)$ are cocartesian; each fiber is equivalent to $L_i$, compatibly with $q_i$ and the actual fiber inclusion. Its coherent sections are the full relative functor simplicial set $\operatorname{Fun}_{N(I)}(N(I),G)$ of [def-cbc-enhanced-cartesian-fibration], with simplices over the identity on the whole index nerve, and their evaluations. The strict lift on cofibrant sections is normalized by $(i,X_i)$, $(\alpha,t_\alpha)$, and the component maps of section morphisms.
